# Debug-build stack trace for the DXIL crash reported in #5632 (ask A)

#     -c "sxe -c \"kb 8; gh\" e0000001; g; q" ^
#     <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe ^
#     -HV 2021 -T ps_6_7 -enable-16bit-types repro.hlsl
#
# `sxe -c "kb 8; gh" e0000001` breaks on the C++-exception-style LLVM assert (0xe0000001),

# driver finally reports the plain "Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert" that `run --issue
# 5632` captured in out-main-debug.txt with no stack (dxc.exe's own top-level handler does not
# print one).
#
# main-debug self-reports commit 7665270b9 / dxcompiler.dll 1.9.0.5465 (triage, 7665270b9),
# verified equivalent to public commit 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df (see
# notes.md "Ground truth" section for the tree-diff control).
